newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares finish slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares finish slightly higher.

text.p: Hungarian shares closed mixed on Wednesday, but gainers outnumbered losers and helped the BUX index to rise.
The BUX index closed at 5.878.39 points, up 45.15 points or 0.77 percent. Spot share turnover totalled four billion forints, down from 4.33 billion forints on Tuesday.
Traders said most shares moved little and the market was awaiting incentives from two heavyweight issues, oil and gas company MOL and drug maker Richter.
"If MOL and Richter do not move then the other papers do not do anything extraordinary," said Istvan Imrich of IBB Securities.
MOL finished down 30 forints at 3,420 in busy trading, while Richter closed up 400 forints at 14,600 forints, in very low turnover with inly 3,605 shares changing hands, traders said.

The first quarter earnings reports of drug maker Egis, meat processor Pick and home improvement product maker Graboplast published earlier on Wednesday, did not move the market as expectations of generally good results had already been built into prices, traders said.
However, each of the three companies closed higher, although Egis, which had slightly weaker results, almost stagnated.
Egis closed at 10.650 forints. Pick firmed 185 forints to 11,400, while Graboplast rose 200 forints, to finish at 8,600 forints.
